unit_sale_price.non_compliance_reason: Rule 6(11) prescribes only the form of a unit sale price declaration -- 'The unit sale price shall be declared as' -- and the Rule 6(1) enumerated list (a), (aa), (b), (c), (d), (da), (e), (f), (g) carries no unit-sale-price item. The corpus therefore holds no obligation limb a deterministic rule could find in breach, so a missing declaration routes to human review rather than FAIL. Source: rules-corpus/LMPC-2011__amended-to-2021-10-31__maharashtra-compilation.pdf, Rule 6(11).

notes: Reverse face of the same pouch. It repeats the marketer, consumer care, manufacturer and country-of-origin blocks but carries no net quantity, no retail sale price and no packing date -- the sharpest asymmetry in this set, and the reason those three fields are INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE here while being PASS or REVIEW_REQUIRED on food_aarambh_oats_1_5kg_001. Nothing is carried across. No reference object of known size is in frame, so no millimetre letter or numeral height is measurable and no Rule 7 Table-I finding is supportable. pdp.is_measurable is false and every height field is null. The sample verdict is REVIEW for that reason alone, independently of what the declarations show.
